4109448.title: Semiwon Water Lily Festival
4109448.overview: Semiwon is a water garden at the point where the north and south branches of the Han River meet, with Paldang Lake on three sides — Gyeonggi-do's first designated provincial garden, laid out in the Korean traditional style. This autumn festival is built around its water lilies: the enormous Victoria amazonica whose leaves carry a child's weight, Australian species, and tropical varieties in every colour. The grounds also hold a lotus museum, a fountain built from onggi jars, and a replica of the pontoon bridge the Joseon scholar Jeong Yak-yong designed for King Jeongjo's procession. In 2026 it also hosts the Gyeonggi Garden Culture Expo. About an hour east of Seoul.

1719499.title: Seoro Market: Chuseok Edition
1719499.overview: A direct-from-the-farm market in Seoul Plaza in the run-up to Chuseok, where producers from across the country sell the ingredients people buy for the holiday. Beyond the stalls it runs as a cultural event: a hundred-cook Chuseok table demonstration with master artisans, a traditional mill where you can watch grain being pressed, a moonlight photo zone with hanbok, folk games, and a persimmon-tree capsule event. There is a parcel desk on site so you can ship what you buy rather than carry it. Free to enter, in the plaza outside Seoul City Hall.

2877219.title: Daegu Maker Festa
2877219.overview: A maker festival at the Samsung Creative Campus in Daegu — a complex built inside the company's original 1930s factory site — running under the slogan 'Beyond imagination, make it together'. Exhibits and hands-on booths cover making, science, technology, art and starting a business, with schools, makerspaces, companies and institutions all setting up. Open to anyone; much of it is aimed at school-age visitors but the fabrication demonstrations are worth a look regardless. Free.
2877219.sponsor: Daegu Metropolitan City · Daegu Office of Education

3000969.title: Hanam Iseongsanseong Fortress Festival
3000969.overview: Excavations at Iseongsanseong, a hilltop fortress above Hanam, turned up a yogo — an hourglass drum, and the oldest percussion instrument found in Korea. The 2026 festival takes that drumbeat as its theme, 'Hanam's history, drumming toward the future', and links two sites: the fortress itself and Misa Lake Park down in the city where people actually spend their weekends. The programme is built for taking part rather than looking at — drumming, making, performances into the evening. Free.
3000969.place: Misa Lake Park lawn and Iseongsanseong Fortress

2618014.title: Inje Autumn Flower Festival
2618014.overview: An autumn garden festival in the mountains of Inje, near the Yongdae tourist area at the foot of Seoraksan. The 2026 edition marks the centenary of Park In-hwan, a leading poet of Korean modernism who was born here, and the planting is arranged along four themed paths named after his lines — a romantic garden and lookout, a wildflower garden and chrysanthemum bonsai display, a lakeside walk with a slow postbox, and a forest section with a tree-climbing course, treehouse and children's woodland. There is a market selling local produce and chrysanthemums, food trucks, performances, and a stamp trail. Free, with some activities charged.

3333059.title: Heritage Media Art: Jinjuseong Fortress
3333059.overview: Jinjuseong was the site of one of the defining sieges of the Imjin War, where General Kim Si-min held the fortress against a far larger Japanese force in 1592. This event projects that history onto the walls themselves after dark — media facade projections, light and sound installations and interactive pieces across Gongbungmun and Chokseongmun gates, Chokseongnu Pavilion and the Yeongnam Pojeongsa government office, each keyed to what happened in that particular spot. Free, and it runs late: 19:30 to 22:30.
3333059.place: Jinjuseong Fortress and Jinju Daecheop History Park
3333059.sponsor: Korea Heritage Service · Gyeongsangnam-do · Jinju City
